newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan can use reserves quickly in forex market-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan can use reserves quickly in forex market-MOF.

text.p: Japan can use its $220 billion worth of external reserves in the foreign exchange market promptly if needed, a Ministry of Finance (MOF) official told Reuters on Wednesday.

Earlier on Wednesday, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of MOF's International Finance Bureau, said it would be difficult to procure funds for foreign exchange intervention directly from the money market.

The other MOF official said there are no problems with the current intervention system in which most of the funds for intervention are procured through the issuing of special foreign exchange bills, called financing bills (FBs), that have been mostly underwritten by the Bank of Japan (BOJ).

The MOF official said Sakakibara's remarks meant there would be some problems in the method raising funds from the market directly without the BOJ's purchase of bills. -Tokyo Treasury market --81-3-3432-1396
